baseline.commit_a32_subject: A32 BETA HARDWARE FINALIZER: touchscreen alive (normal-boot fix), launcher parity + cache invalidation, DECON colour conversion, ten-zone cutout safe areas, phone buttons (power/volume/Bixby), full boot animation
baseline.phone_deployment_note: The A32 hashes were recorded as verified on the target in the A32 record. This run has no live phone console (see docs/beta-finalization/preflight/ENVIRONMENT.md section 6), so the guard compares the *built* artefacts in build/out/s10plus/a32/ against those recorded hashes instead of re-reading the phone.

invariants.title: Launcher/PWA cache invalidation (A32 briq A31)
invariants.why: After an A32 deployment the previous launcher stayed alive because the service worker kept serving ./js/*.js from its old cache namespace. The invariant: a redeployed launcher is never served from a stale cache. Three legs must all hold - (a) the SW namespace is versioned and 'activate' deletes the old namespaces, (b) code assets are network-first, (c) the host purges the WebKit caches and version-stamps the launcher URL.

files.role: service worker: versioned cache namespace + activate purge
app registry bridge used by the launcher
host-side cache purge + URL version stamp

assertions.label: SW cache namespace is explicitly versioned
SW activate deletes the previous cache namespaces
SW activate handler present
launcher registers the service worker
launcher reacts to a new SW becoming available
host purges the launcher caches at startup
host purges the SW cache namespaces on disk
launcher URL carries a version stamp

invariants.title: XRGB8888 -> DECON ABGR8888 colour conversion
invariants.why: The panel's DECON maps R@0 G@8 B@16 while the compositor hands the bridge XRGB8888 (R@16 G@8 B@0). Copying the words unchanged swapped red and blue on the glass. The invariant: the R<->B swap stays in the scanout path and the binary still reproduces the A32 selftest vectors.

files.role: the bridge: conversion + animation gate + screen on/off

assertions.label: source XRGB8888 handled explicitly
destination ABGR_8888 order documented in the source
R<->B swap constant present (red must land in the blue byte slot)
selftest entry point retained
aarch64 colour selftest (real binary) passes
built bridge hash == the hash deployed and verified on the phone in A32

invariants.title: Ten-zone status-bar safe areas, S10+ preset = zones 9,10 in portrait
invariants.why: The S10+ camera cutout sits in the top-right of portrait. A32 introduced a ten-zone model with per-device and per-orientation presets and moved the battery cluster 112 px clear of zones 9-10. The invariant: the model stays ten-zone and the S10+ portrait preset stays [9,10].

assertions.label: persisted document declares ten zones
S10+ portrait preset blocks zones 9,10
S10+ landscape_left blocks nothing
persisted document carries schema_version
engine preset for s10plus is [9,10] in portrait
device profile detection keys on the real hardware identity
safe-zone engine assertions (node)
assertions.note: This suite file is being extended by bg-02 while the parallel build runs, so its in-flight assertions are NOT an A32 invariant. The A32 ten-zone behaviour is gated hard by the four json_eq assertions on configs/nuxel/statusbar-safezones.json and the two regex assertions on pwa/nuxel-home/js/safe-zones.js; this suite is reported as a soft signal (WARN when it fails).

invariants.title: Hardware button manager is the single owner of power/volume/assistant
invariants.why: A32 made one process the only handler of the gpio_keys key set (114 VOLUMEDOWN, 115 VOLUMEUP, 116 POWER, 703 assistant), so POWER short toggles the display through nuxel-wl-fb without a second framebuffer owner and volume drives the real ALSA element. The invariant: that ownership model and its service definition survive.

files.role: the manager: key map, ALSA volume, display toggle, OSD

assertions.label: key device resolved by capability/name, not by a hard-coded eventN

unit restarts the manager

assistant key maps to an action, not a dead key

invariants.title: Live USB console stays reachable and respawning
invariants.why: The CDC-ACM console is the only channel that can inspect a running Nuxel without flashing and without adb. The ACM tty raises SIGHUP when a host attaches, so the supervisor must respawn the shell, and the initramfs must launch it before switch_root. The invariant: the console binary, its launch point and the host-side driver script all stay in place.

assertions.label: console supervisor respawns the shell after SIGHUP
console runs in a forked child so it cannot delay boot
initramfs starts the console before switch_root
console host script is executable
host script enumerates the CDC-ACM node
console node presence (informational; a live phone is not required)

invariants.title: The full A32 offline suite still runs (soft signal while other groups edit shared suites)
invariants.why: A32's evidence is `tools/s10plus/a32/tests/run-tests.sh` exiting 0 with 0 failing suites. The guard re-runs it on every invocation so a regression in the colour selftest, the keycode bitmap decode, the safe-zone engine, the launcher registry or the wallpaper asset is visible immediately. It is a soft assertion because two of the suites it drives (safe-zones-test.js, and by extension the safe-zone engine) belong to bg-02 and are legitimately mid-flight during the parallel build: a failure there is reported as WARN naming the owning group, never as a silent pass and never as a false baseline regression.

files.role: the A32 offline suite entry point (re-run as the gate)

assertions.label: full A32 offline suite (colour selftest, keycode bitmap, safe zones, launcher registry, wallpaper)

history.detail: Register created by briq-00d. A32 gate executed first: bash tools/s10plus/a32/tests/run-tests.sh -> exit 0, 0 failing suites.
colour selftest assertion given exec_fallback=vm after measuring that this host cannot exec aarch64 Linux ELF (exec format error, rc=126).

host_cannot_exec_aarch64_elf: Measured 2026-10-16: executing build/out/s10plus/a32/nuxel-wl-fb on this macOS host fails with 'exec format error' (rc=126). tools/s10plus/a32/tests/run-tests.sh therefore takes its documented fallback and runs the colour selftest on the UTM Fedora 43 aarch64 guest. Any assertion whose subject is an aarch64 ELF must carry exec_fallback=vm.
